question: What practice concerning the soul has been told to the addressed one, and to whom is it addressed?
premises: This practice of the soul has been told.
It has been told to you.
inference: The practice of the soul has been told to you, O Bhairavī.
uncertainties: The details of that practice are not given in these tokens.
plain_english: This practice of the soul has been told to you, and to you, O Bhairavī.
